purpose: Budget default agent orientation and keep compact live authorities from regrowing into narrative notebooks.
measurement: UTF-8 bytes are the stable proxy. Optional drill-down does not count against route budgets. Individual authority budgets are declared in each authority document header so editors see them before changing the file.
